content: Ya꞉suti Yunapino Watodawa Nikadimasikoba꞉ Tabo Da꞉ga꞉laniya꞉
Ba꞉ba tetelo Yunapino eta watodawate nemedenami, ebeno mahilo Nikadimasitila, ebe ba꞉ Pa꞉lisi kapiyuimidawa etala.

Eta dulu ebete Ya꞉sutamo penate na꞉pegoeniya꞉, “Iya꞉tulamedawa, a komopa꞉te iya꞉tawahala ama꞉ ba꞉ Godote poemiya꞉ta a kopiya꞉tua꞉mema꞉, mabu Godote kebe lumagigodolo emedenaheno, ebete ama꞉le dododilinaka ba꞉bako hanohano komo ododilima꞉ a꞉kamodobamene.”

Ya꞉suti ebeno tabo ba huiyana na꞉goeniya꞉, “Na ama꞉tamo hibi tabonomo begoemo, lumagiti ulinoma꞉ eda꞉lo ba꞉be uli ka꞉ka꞉mo gala hawakalaheno, Godote Ko Gawadubuma꞉ deda꞉na ebete ba꞉be komoeno ipuwa a꞉kuma꞉mene.”

Ba꞉bema꞉ Nikadimasiti Ya꞉suku nalateda꞉niya꞉, “Lumagiti kadelema꞉ deda꞉na, ba꞉ba tetelo ebete ulinoma꞉ gala keba ka꞉na na꞉keda꞉mene? Gabohenola, mabu ebete ebeno menokoeno tepo ipuwamo opegate menokote ebe gala alahimi modoboha꞉!”

Ya꞉suti ebetamo na꞉huiyaniya꞉, “Nale ama꞉tamo hibi tabo begoemo, lumagiti beyamo ba꞉gala Godokono Gobogoboeno heloamo ulinoma꞉ eda꞉heno, Godote Ko Gawadubuma꞉ deda꞉na ebete ba꞉be habamo a꞉kana꞉pa꞉gamene.
Ba꞉moe hopo habalo lumagiti da꞉hawakaluya꞉ ba꞉ba tetelo ebeno ka꞉ka꞉te menoko nabiwi iba꞉godone puluhukuya꞉, huiyatiya ebeno gobogoboeno hibi ka꞉ka꞉te Godokono Gobogobogodone kopema꞉ne,
ba꞉bema꞉ tawakaluba꞉te ulinoma꞉ eda꞉hate gala hawakalahalema꞉ da꞉goemo, ba꞉be komoma꞉ ama꞉ akala꞉wa꞉la꞉.

Lumagiti Godokono Gobogoboeno heloamo ulinoma꞉ eda꞉lo ba꞉be uli ka꞉ka꞉go gala da꞉kahawakalamene ba꞉be komo ba꞉ ba꞉ma ka꞉nala. Ba꞉moe hopolo huhuti ha꞉kiya ebeno ubilo hiya꞉hiya꞉ hapuni da꞉pa꞉muta, ama꞉le ebeno diyamo kapiya bulitata huiyatiya huhuti kebene ka꞉petupuimita ba꞉gala keba hapulu ka꞉niwibuta ama꞉ iya꞉tawaha꞉.”
Nikadimasiti huiyatiya Ya꞉sutamo na꞉goeniya꞉, “Amia꞉no taboeno ipuwa na hidamo kalaweha꞉. Ba꞉moe komo keba ka꞉nala꞉ka꞉?”
Ba꞉bene Ya꞉suti ebeno tabo ba huiyana na꞉goeniya꞉, “Ama꞉ ba꞉ Isalaela tawakalubino iya꞉tulamedawa etalata, huiyatiya mabu keka꞉ ama꞉ ba꞉moe komoeno ipuwa kiya꞉tawanaha꞉?

Na ama꞉tamo hibi tabonomo begoemo, naeno kapiyuimipa꞉go ale diya꞉tawahanama꞉ ba꞉bi komo bega꞉lanakoma꞉, ba꞉gala ale ya꞉lo dulamiya꞉ma꞉ ba꞉bi komo bikiyahanakoma꞉, huiyatiya la꞉ komo Yunapa꞉te aeno tabo a꞉kulia꞉lemata.

Iyo, nale ba꞉ma tetelo la꞉ hopo haboeno komokomo da꞉kiyahalamenakoma, la꞉ huiyatiya hibima꞉ kamidilinaha꞉, ba꞉bema꞉ nale Godokono Hunu Haboeno komokomo la꞉ gala da꞉kakiyahalamema, diyala, la꞉ ba꞉ atumu hibima꞉ a꞉kamidila꞉mata.

Ba꞉ hibila, hopo habanapi ipuwalo eta lumagiti Godokono Hunu Habamo kanodoluya꞉ha꞉, huiyatiya Tawakalubino Naniwiti Hunu Habane ba꞉moe hopamo a꞉pihitiguya꞉, ba꞉bema꞉ ebe kapiyate iya꞉tawala Hunu Haboeno komokomo.

“Ba꞉gala eta komo, Mosesete dito hopolo eta kalu auli ilinamo ododiti kukamo keba ka꞉na kadipatiya꞉, wadiyala ama꞉ ba꞉be komo nemalagidola. Ba꞉ba tetelo bu kalate Isalaelanapi ipuwalo pui daloholiya꞉, ba꞉ba꞉te Mosesekono auli kalutamo da꞉gahilameholiya꞉, Godote ibino ka꞉ka꞉ ba꞉bo mula꞉lelamiya꞉. Ba꞉bema꞉ hibila, ba꞉ma tetelo Godote ba꞉ atu gabodo Tawakalubino Naniwi hunamo kadipatema꞉ne,
ba꞉bene puya꞉te ebe hibima꞉ da꞉midimina꞉ iba꞉te wiboha꞉ ka꞉ka꞉ ba꞉bo kolawema꞉na꞉.

Mabu Godote ba꞉moe hopo tawakalubi malemalelo konomamo ba emalagidole ebeno Gudu kapiyanomo ba꞉moe hopo habamo ba꞉bo poemiya꞉, ba꞉bema꞉ puya꞉te ebe hibima꞉ da꞉midimina꞉ ibino ka꞉ka꞉te a꞉kalatidihamena꞉ huiyatiya iba꞉te wiboha꞉ ka꞉ka꞉ kolawema꞉na꞉.

“Ba꞉ hibila, Godote ebeno Gudu da꞉poemiya꞉, ba꞉ba tetelo ebe ubi kihatiya꞉ha꞉ ebeno Guduti tawakalubino komo anagilamelelamete kuba huiya kikalamema꞉, ao, huiyatiya ebe ubila ebete ibino ka꞉ka꞉ kopemula꞉lelamema꞉.

Ba꞉bema꞉ puya꞉te Godokono Gudu hibima꞉ da꞉midina Godote iba꞉tamo kuba huiya a꞉kikalama꞉mene, huiyatiya puya꞉te ebe hibima꞉ midihino Godote ebeno ukui ya꞉lo ihatiya꞉ iba꞉tamo kuba huiya kikalamema꞉, mabu iba꞉te hibima꞉ midi ipuwalo ebeno Gudu kapiyanomo kalaweha꞉.

Numa꞉, Godokono alote ba꞉moe hopamo da꞉piya꞉ iba꞉te ubiha꞉ma꞉ eda꞉huya꞉, huiyatiya ibi ubila du ipuwalo kemedehonama꞉ mabu ibino ododili komokomo kubakubanomola. Iyo, kuba ododilipa꞉te hido alo ubiha꞉ma꞉ ba eda꞉ha alo ipuwamo a꞉kapelama꞉la꞉, mabu ibi ubihinola alote ibino kuba a꞉la꞉minalelame, ba꞉bema꞉ hibila, ibino kuba anagiya꞉mida komote iba꞉tamo kuluhukuma꞉ne.
Huiyatiya puya꞉te Godokono hibi gabodo da꞉tolamena iba꞉te alo ipuwamo kopelamema꞉na꞉, ba꞉bene iba꞉te hidohido komo Godokono heloamo ba ododili alote ibino hibi komo ba꞉bo kohawakalilamema꞉ne.”
Tawakalubi Beyamo Wadulateledawa Yonete Ya꞉sukunu Komo Da꞉hawakalimiya꞉

Ba꞉be komo da꞉wibuya꞉ Ya꞉suti ebe ta꞉matapa꞉go Yudiya hopamo tolamete, iba꞉te ba꞉bolo tete ga꞉ga꞉dopolo ba nemede komo tawakaluba꞉te beyamo aduti komo lawema꞉ da꞉pelamenakui Ya꞉suti ibi ba꞉bo owalubilinakui.
Ba꞉gala atu tetelo komo tawakaluba꞉te Yonetamo da꞉pelamenakui, ebete ibi Inono haba tamelo atumu kawadulatelenakui mabu ba꞉bolo beya kodopola, ba꞉be Inono habate Salimi haba tatalilo itana.
Ba꞉ba tetelo gabomana꞉te Yoneko du genama guamo ihatehenola.
Ba꞉bene eta hegelalo Yoneko ta꞉matapa꞉te eta Yunapi dubago tawakalubino apeno dalowa꞉ ukulale komoma꞉ olowabeletihuiya꞉.

Ba꞉bema꞉ komo iba꞉te ba꞉be tabo ga꞉la ipuwane Yonetamo pelamete ebe na꞉pega꞉lamiya꞉, “Iya꞉tulamedawa, dopamo Yodane Tuli hapulu ama꞉tamo da꞉puluhukui ba꞉be dubuino komo ama꞉le atamo da꞉hawakalimi, ebete gala kapete tawakalubi beyamo ba꞉pewadulatelenate, ba꞉gala tawakalubi hiliyonomate a miya꞉poete ebetamo ba꞉ na꞉tolama꞉.”
Yonete ibino tabo ba huiya na꞉goiya꞉, “Lumagiti hido komo ha꞉kiya a꞉kalawa꞉mene, Godote ebetamo ikameheno ebete dito kolutama꞉ne.
Nale la꞉tamo da꞉goimo, la꞉ ba꞉be tabo hibilo ulihuimata. Iyo, na ba꞉ma ka꞉na goimo, ‘Na Godokono Oemedawa Kelisoteha꞉, huiyatiya Godote na na꞉poenamiya꞉ Kelisoko dopamete kotoma꞉.’

Eta dubuti uli kamena da꞉lawemene, ebete poko ododiti ba꞉be kamenate hibinomolo ebenoma꞉ keda꞉ma꞉ne. Ba꞉ba tetelo ba꞉be dubuino hido mabulubiti nanekela꞉mo ebe tama꞉mo nutiti, ebeno mabulubino tabo madodo uliti ebeno ko kalakala dumimini, ebete atumu kokalakalama꞉ne. Ba꞉ hibila, na ba꞉ ba꞉ba ka꞉nala, Kelisoko mabuma꞉ naeno tepo ipuwalo kalakala konomote a꞉tabui,
ba꞉bema꞉ wadiyala ebete koma꞉ neda꞉mene, na huiyatiya deha꞉potoma꞉ keda꞉ma꞉nemo.”
Hunu Habane Da꞉pihitiguya꞉ Ba꞉be Kodawoeno Komo

Godokono Hunu Habane da꞉pihitiguya꞉ ba꞉be Kodawate hopo tawakalubi hiliyonomo na꞉gogolena. Kebe lumagiti ba꞉moe hopolo demedena, ebe ba꞉ ba꞉moe hopoeno komoma꞉ olamaginako mabu ebe ba꞉ hopo lumagila, huiyatiya Hunu Habane da꞉piya꞉ ba꞉be dawa eba ka꞉naha꞉. Ebete ba꞉moe hopolo ha꞉kiya Kodawanomoma꞉ ba peda꞉na,
Hunu Habalo kebe komokomo kulamiya꞉ ba꞉gala kebe komokomo kulihuya꞉, ebete ba꞉bi komokomo hopo habanapa꞉tamo na꞉pehawakalilamena, huiyatiya ibi ipuwalo komo hiliyonomate ebeno tabo a꞉kalawa꞉la꞉.
Ba꞉be mabuma꞉ kebe lumagiti ebeno tabo hibinomolo da꞉lawemene, ebete ba꞉be komodo ba꞉moe eta komo kohawakalimima꞉ne, Godoko kapiya ba꞉ hibi komo hawakalimidawala.
Ba꞉ hibila, Godote da꞉poemiya꞉ ba꞉be Kodawate Godokono hibi tabo bolamaginako, mabu Godote ebeno Gobogoboeno helo konomo ebetamo ya꞉lo ikamiya꞉,
iyo, Nabiwi Godote ebeno Gudu malemalelo nemalagidolona, ba꞉bema꞉ ebete ebetamo helo ikamiya꞉ ebete hiliyonomo komokomo ododilima꞉.

Ba꞉be mabuma꞉ kebe lumagiti Godokono Gudu hibima꞉ da꞉midina, Godokono wiboha꞉ ka꞉ka꞉te ebegodolo bitana, ebete ya꞉lo a꞉lawi, huiyatiya kebe lumagiti Godokono Gudutamo papamiwataheno, Godokono konomo mauba komote ebetamo bitana ba꞉bema꞉ ebete hibi ka꞉ka꞉ a꞉kalawenamene.
